title: Read-only generated-document reviewed-package verifier CLI
target_user: A local reviewer or operator checking a downloaded completed-review ZIP without starting DecisionDoc
observed_problem: The existing standalone CLI verifies original generated-document packets, while the completed-review ZIP verifier is only callable as a Python function. An operator must write a Python invocation to check the downloaded outer package and receipt together.

evidence.observation: This CLI calls verify_generation_export_packet and reports only original packet verification.
A pure verifier already validates the completed-review ZIP, embedded packet, canonical receipt and manifest, hashes, sizes, types, and false authority.
Standalone integrity verification must distinguish JSON booleans from numeric values even when the archive is otherwise self-consistent.

current_workaround: Call the Python verifier manually from the repository, or rely on the authenticated server download path; neither provides a dedicated standalone completed-package CLI command.
desired_outcome: One local read-only command checks the exact downloaded completed-review ZIP and prints a minimal deterministic verification summary without exposing private review content or implying issuer authenticity.
acceptance_criteria: Add scripts/verify_generated_document_reviewed_package.py using the existing pure verifier; do not change its schema or duplicate archive validation logic.
Read one regular non-symlink local file with the existing reviewed-package size limit and a bounded read; reject invalid, oversized, unreadable, or changed-size input without extraction or writes.

Success exits zero and prints exactly schema_version, status, packet_sha256, completion_receipt_sha256, reviewed_package_sha256, reviewed_package_size_bytes, review_decision, and operational_approval as deterministic JSON. Use schema_version decisiondoc.generated_document_reviewed_package.verification.v1, status verified, and strict operational_approval false.
Default output excludes rationale, reviewer identity, tenant, project, document, request, bundle, title, operation, timestamps, local path, and all receipt bodies.
Invalid content or IO failure produces a fixed non-disclosing stderr message, empty stdout, and nonzero exit without traceback or payload disclosure; argparse usage errors remain usage errors.
Accepted, changes_requested, and rejected receipts all verify as evidence without being promoted to business approval, source currentness, issuer authenticity, or permission to act.

Tests cover valid deterministic output, tampered packet/receipt/manifest, duplicate or extra members, type drift, oversize, missing/nonregular/symlink input, read-size drift, private-field redaction, unchanged input hashes, and no backend or network access.
affected_boundaries: docs/product_execution_plan.md, docs/test_plan.md, docs/development-plan.md and README.md usage and verification evidence
tracked portfolio documentation mirror through the existing sync tool

allowed_effects: read the user-selected local ZIP without extraction
print a redacted verification summary or fixed failure message
create isolated test fixtures and update coupled local documentation
excluded_effects: start the application, open StateBackend, or alter records, packets, assignments or receipts
re-complete, reassign, approve, repair, delete, notify or publish a review
read environment secrets or credentials, install packages, or access providers, AWS, G2B, Docker, databases or network endpoints
change authentication, tenant isolation, archive schemas, the pure verifier, or existing CLI contracts
separate_approval_required_for: any expanded file or behavior scope
commit, push, merge, publication, deployment or paid/external execution

local_verification.proves: The candidate is structurally valid; a draft is not admitted for implementation.
This must fail until a separate explicit decision admits the exact candidate.
Planned after admission: the new CLI test file proves deterministic, redacted, read-only success and closed failure behavior. This file does not exist at draft time.
The existing original-packet, review API and storage behavior remains compatible.

decision.rationale: The repository operator explicitly approved completing the proposed local CLI, regression tests and coupled documentation in the current task, bound to draft SHA-256 d44ffb960c266ab5f1bb525e88596238184b36a27ed4f8bb3c3d048efb7dce22. Preserve the existing completion approval and every excluded effect; no commit, push, paid call or existing data mutation is authorized.
